instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: At 1800, 12 hours after a major thermal burn, an intubated 80-kg client with 31.5% TBSA burns has achieved improved blood pressure and heart rate after lactated Ringer's resuscitation. Urine output is now 120 mL/hr for two consecutive hours, above the ordered target of 40 to 80 mL/hr. New bilateral basilar crackles are present, peak airway pressures are rising, abdominal girth is increasing, the hematocrit has fallen from 52% to 38%, and previously unburned hands are tense and edematous. The burn team notes that delivered volume has exceeded the time-phased expected Parkland trajectory by about 20%. Complete the bowtie by selecting the most likely condition, two priority actions, and two parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Increase ventilator support without changing the fluid rate

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Maintain or increase the infusion because resuscitation continues for 24 hours

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Reduce the lactated Ringer's infusion rate

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Notify the burn team and begin serial bladder-pressure and extremity-perfusion monitoring

condition.label: C2
condition.text: Worsening inhalation injury as the primary problem
